A partial proof 
claimed by Lezhe Gao (using DeepSeek & GPT-5.5).
 Summary:
 Assuming \(\mathrm{MA}_{\aleph_1}\), we prove for every finite \(k\ge1\),\[
\omega_1^2 \to (\omega_1\omega,\underbrace{3,\ldots,3}_{k})^2_{k+1}.
\]The main lemma states that any ordinal \(\alpha\) with \(\alpha\to(\alpha,3)^2\) also satisfies the finite-color version with additional targets \(3\). The proof merges colors and applies induction, then splits the merged color. Baumgartner’s theorem gives \(\omega_1\omega\to(\omega_1\omega,3)^2\) under \(\mathrm{MA}_{\aleph_1}\), and since \(\omega_1\omega\) is an initial segment of \(\omega_1^2\), the result follows. The ZFC case remains open.
